title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 2: Elijah taken up by a whirlwind, Elisha's double portion, the healed water and the youths of Bethel.

questions.text: From which place did Elijah go with Elisha when Yahweh was about to take him up?
questions.explanation: When Yahweh was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

questions.text: What did Elisha answer when Elijah first asked him to wait?
questions.explanation: When Elijah asked him to wait, Elisha said, 'As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.'

answers.text: As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.
I will wait here until you return to me.
Let me first go back and kiss my father.
Go in peace, my master, and do not fear.

questions.text: What did Elijah use to strike the waters of the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Elijah took his mantle, rolled it up and struck the waters, and they were divided so that both went over on dry ground.

questions.text: What did Elisha ask Elijah for before he was taken away?
questions.explanation: Elisha said, 'Please let a double portion of your spirit be on me.'

answers.text: A double portion of his spirit
A blessing for his father's house

questions.text: What separated Elijah and Elisha as they walked and talked?
questions.explanation: A chariot of fire and horses of fire separated them, and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

answers.text: A chariot of fire and horses of fire
A pillar of cloud and smoke
An angel with a drawn sword
A river that rose up between them

questions.text: What did Elisha do with his own clothes after he saw Elijah no more?
questions.explanation: Elisha took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.

answers.text: He burned them by the Jordan
He gave them to the prophets
He tore them in two pieces
He left them on the riverbank

questions.text: What did the sons of the prophets at Jericho say when they saw Elisha?
questions.explanation: When the sons of the prophets at Jericho saw him, they said, 'The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha,' and bowed before him.

answers.text: Elijah has come back to us again.
Yahweh has taken our master from us.
Elisha has crossed the Jordan in vain.
The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.

questions.text: For how long did the fifty men search for Elijah?
questions.explanation: The fifty men searched for three days, but did not find him.

questions.text: What did Elisha put into a new jar to heal the bad water of the city?
questions.explanation: Elisha asked for a new jar with salt in it, threw the salt into the spring and said that Yahweh had healed the waters.

questions.text: What came out of the woods after Elisha cursed the youths who mocked him?
questions.explanation: Elisha cursed them in Yahweh's name, and two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of the youths.
